messages:
alex: Late-night check — we plan to slice-roll release/2026-03 (model-serving v2.1.3) across US -> EU -> APAC starting 02:00 UTC. Can ops confirm go/no-go per region?
marco: quick status — warm pools spun, canaries ran in US. queue depth low. waiting on EU warm-up logs from infra job.
jen: tagging @sre-oncall — can we get thermal/capacity readouts? particularly EU GPUs and APAC spot availability.
sre-oncall: saw a small OOM on eu-pool during canary step 2 earlier, patched kernel param. running a 15m soak now. no alerting firing.
deploy-bot: preflight report for thread 6410123456:
```
US: healthy (warm=12, target=10, latency p95=120ms)
EU: degraded (warm=6, target=9) — infra-warm job in progress
APAC: healthy (warm=8, target=7) but spot reclaim risk ~12% next 2h
All: canaries OK, rollout plan pinned -> model-serving:v2.1.3
``` 
marco: EU short by 3 warm instances — how long to reach target? ops?
ops-bot: infra-warm job ETA ~8m to reach target if no throttles. current API quota headroom 18%.
dara: if EU doesn't hit warm target we should pin EU to v2.1.2 fallback. I'd prefer a soft-pin and manual confirmation before APAC.
alex: agree. plan: start US (10%), wait 10m, check SLOs + error budget, then EU decision point, then APAC. rollback criteria: >2% user-facing error increase or p95 > 300ms for 5m.
jen: putting the rollback playbook in thread — copy of checks:
- deploybot status OK
- warm pool >= target
- p95 < 200ms (service)
- error rate delta < 1.5% vs baseline
- no new SLO alerts
sre-oncall: EU soak still running, currently warm=7 after patch. p95 stable at 180ms. alerting quiet.
marco: if EU stalls, we do a canary rollback to v2.1.2 and hold. who will execute rollback? @alex?
alex: I'll run rollback if EU doesn't hit target in next 12m. @marco please prepare a canary-release note for the rollback.
marco: on it. note: informing CS about potential briefly degraded EU performance. drafting now.
deploy-bot: kickoff: US -> slice 1 (10%) started 6410123468
alex: US slice green at 02:11 UTC. metrics: errors steady, latency p95=115ms. proceeding to EU warm completion.
ops-bot: infra-warm job completed at 6410123512. EU warm=9 target met.
jen: EU warm target met and no SLO deltas. proceeding to EU canary (10%).
alex: EU slice started 6410123525
sre-oncall: EU canary OK for 8m, p95=190ms, error delta 0.2% :thumbsup:
marco: APAC warm status before we flip? any spot churn alerts?
ops-bot: APAC spot risk reduced to 6% after reprovision. warm=9 target=7. safe to proceed if we keep burst policy off.
dara: suggest keeping burst off for first 30m in APAC. if something spikes we fallback to US models.
alex: agreed. starting APAC 6410123570 (20% slice with burst disabled). monitor for 15m.
deploy-bot: APAC slice started 6410123570
alex: monitoring. if APAC p95 > 250ms for 5m -> rollback APAC. if errors > 1.5% -> immediate rollback.
jen: adding release note: "release/2026-03 model-serving v2.1.3 — staged geo rollout. US/EU/APAC. Rollback triggers defined in thread." sharing with #release-notes.
marco: great work team. postmortem item: investigate EU warm failure root cause (kernel param default) and add to runbook.
sre-oncall: will open a ticket and assign next sprint. :white_check_mark:
alex: closing thread when APAC stable for 30m. thanks everyone"
